final_message:
The bug was in `due_for_retry` in `billing/dunning.py`. The tests pass (24), but I didn't add a test for this case or reproduce the 8-attempt count.

The filter used `status == "open" or (next_attempt_at is not None and next_attempt_at <= now)`. Because of the `or`, every open invoice was retried on every `run_cycle`, whatever its scheduled `next_attempt_at`. I changed it to `and`, so an invoice is retried only when it is open and its scheduled retry time has arrived.

I also wrote `answer.json` with `{"file": "dunning.py", "function": "due_for_retry"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && sed -n 40,60p dunning.py; sed -n 50,85p engine.py

cd .. && python - <<'E'
p='billing/dunning.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''if invoice["status"] == "open" or invoice["next_attempt_at"] is not None and invoice["next_attempt_at"] <= now''','''if invoice["status"] == "open" and invoice["next_attempt_at"] is not None and invoice["next_attempt_at"] <= now''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
echo '{"file": "dunning.py", "function": "due_for_retry"}' > answer.json
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
